stem: A field has strong sun exposure but poor vehicle access and no reliable irrigation source. What is the strongest site decision?
choices: Treat access and water as major site constraints before committing the crop
Choose the site because sunlight alone determines suitability
Plant first and transport water manually if needed
Ignore harvest access until late flower
rationale: Outdoor site suitability depends on water, access, drainage, security and operational logistics in addition to light.
